description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Generator_XmlWriter which extends Zend_XmlRpc_Generator_GeneratorAbstract and provides methods for generating XML using PHP's XMLWriter extension, including opening elements, writing text, closing elements, and saving the XML document.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Generator_XmlWriter
classes.description: A class for generating XML documents based on XMLWriter, providing methods to open tags, write text, close tags, and output the XML.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the internal XMLWriter instance and starts the XML document with a specified encoding.

methods.name: _openElement
methods.description: Starts a new XML element with the given name.

methods.name: _writeTextData
methods.description: Writes text data into the current XML element.

methods.name: saveXml
methods.description: Returns the generated XML as a string.
